Extremely Disappointing Service
Aug 2026 • Family
This was my second time visiting Umi Mania, and unfortunately, it will also be my last. I was extremely disappointed with the staff’s attitude and overall customer service, especially for a Japanese restaurant.

Even when I called the restaurant’s hotline to make a reservation, the staff member spoke to me in a very impolite and dismissive manner. The way they communicated immediately gave me a bad impression.

When we arrived, two people in our group were running late, so we started ordering and eating at around 7:30 PM. Our table had a long cushioned bench seat with a backrest. There were supposed to be two separate chairs on the opposite side, but only one was available. I asked a staff member to bring another chair for my family member, but they brought a small stool instead, which was clearly not suitable for the table.

The experience with ordering drinks was also frustrating. I ordered drinks twice from two different staff members, but neither order was brought to our table. The third time, I went to the counter myself and ordered an additional bottle of water. The staff brought the bottled water, but the drink I had previously ordered from the menu was still never served. I even offered to bring the drink to my table myself, but the staff did not allow me to do so.

At around 9:10 PM, the staff informed us that it was time to pay because the restaurant was preparing to close. I completely understood and actually went to the counter to pay myself because I knew the staff needed to close the register.

However, the attitude of the staff during payment was extremely unpleasant. While I was checking the bill, one staff member impatiently asked me, “Are you done yet?” in a rushed and pressuring tone. Another staff member had to gesture to them, after which they finally stopped and waited for me to finish checking the bill.

What made the situation even more uncomfortable was that we still had food left after paying, so we stayed to finish our meal. At around 9:50 PM, the lights above our table were turned off while we were still eating. When I looked over, the staff turned the lights back on, but did not apologize or even explain that it had been turned off by mistake.

There were only three of us, and our bill was over VND 1.9 million (nearly VND 2 million). I don’t expect restaurant staff to provide special treatment, but basic politeness, respect, and attentive service should be the minimum.

The food itself may be good depending on personal taste, but a restaurant experience is not only about the food. Customer service matters just as much. Unfortunately, the staff’s attitude was a major disappointment and did not match the amount of money we spent.

This was my second visit to Umi Mania, and I definitely will not be coming back. I would also think twice before recommending this restaurant to others. The staff’s attitude was a major negative point in an otherwise potentially enjoyable dining experience.

Overall: Very disappointing customer service.

Completely shattered my trust
Dec 2021
First time I found this restaurant and tried the rib-eye, was very happy with the tasty meat. I came back many times afterward and still enjoyed the food there. 
After a long close down due to Covid, I came back again today and ordered a 200gr rib-eye as usual. When the food came out I noticed the colors of the meat were different, definitely they were not coming from the same steak, still continued my meal though. After finishing about 3/4 of the portion, I recognized the taste really different. Few bites were juicy and tender as I used to have before, few were so dry and tough. Noticed the waitress and got a reply they were all rib-eye but one is coming from the edge area, thus dry and tough. 
I was completely disappointed with this explanation. Was thinking they put a chuck flap mixed in for me. Anyway I became pretty skeptical with this restaurant after this incident.
